discrepancies: Deadline: competition page says 11:59 p.m. UTC on Dec. 3, 2026; rules A.1 require posting by 5:00 p.m. ET (22:00 UTC in December) on the deadline date. Plan to the earlier cutoff.
Problem page describes sample_submission.tif as 'total fault absence', but the local sample has 60,988 cells equal to 1.0 (measured in an earlier session). Treat sample as format-only.
Problem page says data outside bounds is 'null or nan'; the shared writer uses 0 outside the footprint. Validator behaviour on zeros is not confirmed.
